meta.name: git-worktree
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to manage Git worktrees - creating worktrees from local or remote branches, listing active worktrees with details, deleting worktrees, or switching between worktrees. Ideal for working on multiple branches simultaneously without stashing changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同时管理多个 Git 工作分支
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时在多个 Git 分支上工作
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work on multiple Git branches at once

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你在同一项目中同时处理多个分支，无需暂存当前工作。它会列出、创建、删除 Git 工作树，并给出切换命令。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 Git 工作树，比如创建、列出、删除或切换工作树时触发。

say.note: Claude 会显示所有工作树的路径和分支。

say.text: 从远程分支 feature-x 创建工作树
say.note: Claude 会拉取远程分支并创建独立工作目录。

say.text: 删除 hotfix-123 的工作树
say.note: Claude 会移除工作树并提示清理命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you work on multiple branches in the same project simultaneously without stashing. It lists, creates, deletes Git worktrees and provides navigation commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage Git worktrees, such as creating, listing, deleting, or switching worktrees.

say_en.note: Claude shows all worktrees with paths and branches.

say_en.text: Create a worktree from remote branch feature-x
say_en.note: Claude fetches the remote branch and creates a separate working directory.
Claude removes the worktree and suggests a prune command.
